snippet.title: Suikoden Card Stories battle
snippet.description:
I don't know much about how to play besides the basic basics and I'm not that far, but here is a quick battle...
Basically you have to use a leader card once you or your enemy plays an objective card then you can use minor people and eventually win it, but there are alot of other things I'm not sure about.
